Method of Attack: Sets up SOCKS5 proxies on victim computers to tunnel/hide malicious traffic associated with other malware
Uses secure HTTP connections to encrypt information sent to command-and-control servers
Bypasses firewall detection of command and control (C2) traffic
Bypasses Internet content filters and hides IP addresses involved in C2 communications
Attack Vector: Exploit kits such as Fallout and RIG
Amadey Loader distributed via RIG EK campaign
Indicators of Compromise: Malware sample hashes (available in Proofpoint's malware analysis)
C2 server domains and IP addresses (available in Proofpoint's malware analysis)
